svg.title: The reranking funnel from 20 candidates to 3 high-signal chunks
svg.desc: A vertical funnel narrowing from 20 candidate chunks at top, through a cross-encoder reranker stage in the middle that filters out off-topic chunks, to 3 high-relevance chunks at the bottom that reach the LLM.
svg.text: Reranker reads query + chunk together, much more precise
